subject: Control assertions and Article 30 extract request — onboarding privacy review
messages:
From: Data Protection <dpo@novamed.com>
To: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Control assertions & Article 30 extract needed for onboarding

Hi Avery,

Thanks for taking the time yesterday. As part of our vendor onboarding checklist we need the following so our privacy team can sign off:

- A short control-assertion document describing how Redwood treats customer data for inference (retention, logging, KMS keys).
- An extract of your Article 30 processing activities register showing the processing purposes and categories relevant to NovaMed.
- Current subprocessor matrix with activation dates and subprocessors handling EU/US transfers.
- A redacted copy of your most recent SOC 2 Type II report (or link) and any monitoring evidence you can share.
- Sample KMS access logs for the last 30 days (redacted user ids are fine).

We aren't asking for raw logs — a short, redacted sample plus the one-page control assertions would help our DPIA and procurement teams close the onboarding. Our target for completion is EOD 16 June.

If you need a DPA or DocuSign routing details, let me know and I will share contacts.

Best,
Rebecca Shaw
Privacy & Compliance Lead
NovaMed Health
rebecca.shaw@novamed.com

--
Note: Please treat this request as confidential.

Hi Rebecca —

Thanks for the clear list. We can provide the requested artifacts and will aim to meet the 16 June target. High-level plan:

- I will assemble a one-page control assertion and the Article 30 excerpt.
- Marissa will prepare a redacted SOC2 link and coordinate log sampling.
- Karthik will confirm the subprocessor activation dates (we will highlight any EU transfers).

We may send a zipped package with filenames and short notes; if you prefer individual links (Drive / DocuSign), tell me which is easiest.

One quick question: for the KMS logs, do you need user-level identities or is a redacted user-id + timestamp sufficient?

Avery Johnson

Marissa / Karthik — forwarding NovaMed's ask below. Action items and proposed owners: 

- One-page control assertion (Avery) — cover retention, inference logging, redaction, KMS key ownership, access review cadence.
- Article 30 register extract (Karthik) — filter to activities relevant to "model inference / embeddings / logs" and include legal basis and recipients.
- Subprocessor matrix (Karthik) — include country, processor role, transfer mechanism (SCCs/BCRs), activation date.
- SOC2 redaction/link + monitoring notes (Marissa) — provide Drive link to redacted report and a 1-paragraph summary of monitoring controls.
- KMS log sample (Marissa) — provide a small redacted sample (timestamps + truncated principal ids).

Deadlines: draft artifacts by Tues EOD (15 Jun) internal review; final package to Rebecca by Wed (16 Jun) morning PT.

Notes: keep the sample artifacts short — NovaMed asked explicitly for a redacted sample, not full log dumps. Attachments should be named clearly and include a readme.txt with brief descriptions.

On quoting Rebecca's email for context:
> We aren't asking for raw logs — a short, redacted sample plus the one-page control assertions would help our DPIA and procurement teams close the onboarding.

Thanks — please flag any blockers.

Avery
